title: Banks rescue a red day: Nifty ends at 25,044.65, an eight-month closing high, as PSU banks jump 3.7% and IT slips
short: Banks lift Nifty to 8-month closing high; IT drags, most stocks fall
dek: The Nifty and Sensex spent most of Monday in the red after the Diwali Muhurat session, then a late push by bank stocks carried both to their highest closes since 27 February. More shares fell than rose.
card: Nifty +58.25 at 25,044.65, Sensex +107.25 at 81,106.65. PSU Bank +3.73%, IT −1.22%. Rupee 93.93. Markets shut Tuesday.
sources: HDFC Sky: Market close report, 9 November 2026
HDFC Sky (PTI): Rupee rises 5 paise to close at 93.93 against US dollar
